import json, os, hmac, hashlib, datetime, urllib.parse, urllib.request
from urllib.parse import urlparse

p = _items[0]['json']
text = (p.get('text') or '').strip()
if not text:
    return [{'json': {'success': False, 'error': 'empty text'}}]
ref_audio = (p.get('ref_audio') or 'narrator_ref_audio_men.wav').strip()
ref_text = (p.get('ref_text') or 'narrator_ref_text.txt').strip()
language = (p.get('language') or 'vi').strip()
speed = float(p.get('speed') or 1.0)
seed = int(p.get('seed') or 42)
pad_ms = int(p.get('pad_ms') or 80)
output_bucket = (p.get('output_bucket') or 'started').strip()
output_key = (p.get('output_key') or 'audio.wav').strip()

endpoint = os.environ.get('MINIO_ENDPOINT', 'http://minio:9000')
access_key = os.environ['MINIO_ACCESS_KEY']
secret_key = os.environ['MINIO_SECRET_KEY']
region = os.environ.get('MINIO_REGION', 'us-east-1')
OMNIVOICE_URL = os.environ.get('OMNIVOICE_URL', 'http://omnivoice:8000/tts')

def s3_put(bucket, key, data, content_type='application/octet-stream'):
    parsed = urlparse(endpoint); host = parsed.netloc
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC)
    amzdate = now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'); datestamp = now.strftime('%Y%m%d')
    payload_hash = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    canonical_uri = '/' + bucket + '/' + urllib.parse.quote(key, safe='/')
    canonical_headers = f'host:{host}\nx-amz-content-sha256:{payload_hash}\nx-amz-date:{amzdate}\n'
    signed_headers = 'host;x-amz-content-sha256;x-amz-date'
    canonical_request = f'PUT\n{canonical_uri}\n\n{canonical_headers}\n{signed_headers}\n{payload_hash}'
    credential_scope = f'{datestamp}/{region}/s3/aws4_request'
    string_to_sign = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256\n{amzdate}\n{credential_scope}\n{hashlib.sha256(canonical_request.encode()).hexdigest()}'
    def _sign(k, m): return hmac.new(k, m.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
    k_date = _sign(('AWS4' + secret_key).encode(), datestamp)
    k_region = _sign(k_date, region); k_service = _sign(k_region, 's3'); k_signing = _sign(k_service, 'aws4_request')
    signature = hmac.new(k_signing, string_to_sign.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    auth = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential={access_key}/{credential_scope}, SignedHeaders={signed_headers}, Signature={signature}'
    rq = urllib.request.Request(f'{endpoint}{canonical_uri}', data=data, method='PUT', headers={
        'Host': host, 'X-Amz-Date': amzdate, 'X-Amz-Content-SHA256': payload_hash,
        'Authorization': auth, 'Content-Type': content_type,
    })
    with urllib.request.urlopen(rq, timeout=180) as resp:
        return resp.status

def tts_call(payload, timeout=900):
    body = json.dumps(payload).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(OMNIVOICE_URL, data=body, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
        return r.read(), r.headers.get('X-Sample-Rate')

payload = {
    'text': text,
    'ref_audio': ref_audio,
    'ref_text': ref_text,
    'language': language,
    'speed': speed,
    'seed': seed,
    'pad_ms': pad_ms,
}

try:
    wav_bytes, sr = tts_call(payload)
except Exception as e:
    return [{'json': {'success': False, 'stage': 'tts', 'error': f'{type(e).__name__}: {e}'}}]

try:
    status = s3_put(output_bucket, output_key, wav_bytes, 'audio/wav')
except Exception as e:
    return [{'json': {'success': False, 'stage': 's3', 'error': f'{type(e).__name__}: {e}'}}]

return [{'json': {
    'success': True,
    'output': f'{output_bucket}/{output_key}',
    'audio_size': len(wav_bytes),
    'sample_rate': sr,
    'ref_audio': ref_audio,
    'status': status,
}}]
